_comment: Phase 4.7R5 classifier A (PERSONAL_SAFETY_ROUTER) dataset. Synthetic, de-identified, hand-authored; NO real user conversations or logs. Each entry is a TEMPLATE FAMILY (a semantic scenario with several surface variants); train/calibration/test split is by FAMILY (no family overlap). label 1 = SAFETY_HANDLING_REQUIRED (routing only — NOT a diagnosis/severity), 0 = NORMAL_QUERY. Written WITHOUT copying sentences from any Phase 4.6-4.7R4 evaluation set; known failure CLASSES (not strings) guided family selection. Surface variation: accented/unaccented VN, mixed VN/EN, first-person explicit/omitted, question/statement, fragments, event->symptom and symptom->event order, exercise term present/absent.
